subject: SaaSify marketplace entitlement exemption - integration & timeline
messages:
From: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@saasify.co>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.ai, marketplace_ops@cloudvendor.com
Date: Tue, 01 Aug 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SaaSify marketplace entitlement/ISV integration - dependency list & exemption request

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with Redwood's latency/profile for streaming inference. We're ready to move forward with the CloudVendor marketplace listing, but their entitlement model requires SKU-level usage entitlements for trial provisioning. Our current product expects the platform to surface an entitlement flag for "trial_concurrency" which Redwood doesn't expose today.

Short summary of asks:
- Can Redwood provide an entitlement mapping API or header for "trial_concurrency" by Aug 20 so we can enable automated provisioning?
- If not possible, can Redwood sign an exception that allows us to list the product with a "limited trial" badge while we ship the integration?

Attached is our tech spec (SaaSify_Marketplace_TechSpec_v3.pdf) showing the expected webhook and entitlement fields. We appreciate any guidance on scope and whether you anticipate billing/reconciliation gaps.

We can be flexible on the exact interface — our integration team (cc'd) can adapt to a short-lived shim if that's easiest.

Best,
Tom
Tom Hayes
Head of Integrations, SaaSify

--
Attachment: SaaSify_Marketplace_TechSpec_v3.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: chloe.martin@redwood.ai
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, irene.choi@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 03 Aug 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SaaSify marketplace entitlement/ISV integration - dependency list & exemption request

Folks — forwarding Tom's note from SaaSify. High level: they need an entitlement flag for trial provisioning that our marketplace adapter doesn't currently surface.

Quick asks from product/dev perspective:
- Ben: how invasive is adding a per-customer entitlement header/hook? Risk to billing pipeline?
- Marcus: infra impact (KV cache, routing) if we add a short-lived entitlement prefix in request metadata?
- Irene: timeline for QA/partner testing and whether we can support a temporary manual reconciliation process if we need an exemption.

They're asking for Aug 20. I've attached the spec Tom sent. If we can't hit that date, we should propose clear alternatives (exception with label, manual reconciliation, or a lightweight shim).

Thanks — chloe

--
Attachment: SaaSify_Marketplace_TechSpec_v3.pdf (forwarded)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, irene.choi@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 05 Aug 2028 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: SaaSify marketplace entitlement/ISV integration - dependency list & exemption request

Chloe — quick technical read: adding an entitlement header for "trial_concurrency" is feasible but not trivial. Work breakdown:
- API change (server-side): ~3 dev-days to accept and persist metadata on request (non-critical path).
- Billing reconciliation: if we need to tie usage to SKU entitlements, billing team needs a clear mapping — otherwise manual reconcile.
- Runtime: adding metadata shouldn't impact token path, but we need a test matrix for batched requests and KV cache keys since entitlements may influence routing.

Short-term options I see:
1) Temporary exemption on CloudVendor: allow listing with a "limited trial" label while we ship the API (fastest to production).
2) Shim layer from SaaSify: they send a header we map to existing customer metadata (fast but needs coordination).
3) Full entitlement support (2–3 sprints including QA), target delivery ~Aug 28 if we pull in resources.

I've sketched the reconciliation mapping in entitlement-matrix.csv (attached) — it lists how we would map marketplace SKUs to Redwood internal plans. If we go with #1 or #2 we can avoid billing changes for now.

Ben
Director, Partner Integrations

--
Attachment: entitlement-matrix.csv (CSV, 12KB)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Aug 2028 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: SaaSify marketplace entitlement/ISV integration - dependency list & exemption request

Thanks Ben — agree with the options. From an integrations/testing standpoint:
- If we pursue the exemption route, we need a documented test window where SaaSify and Redwood run acceptance tests (suggest Aug 21–24). We'll need a staging webhook endpoint and an allowlist of tenant IDs.
- If SaaSify provides a shim that sets the header, we should require a handshake (HMAC) and an idempotency token to avoid duplicate provisioning.
- If we aim for the full API (Aug 28-ish), I'll need 2 QA engineers for three days to validate provisioning + billing flags; also need 24hr smoke tests post rollout.

Action items I propose now:
- Chloe: confirm whether we want to request the marketplace exemption (I'll draft the test plan once we decide).
- Ben: please share any constraints from billing/legal for manual reconciliation if we go exemption route.

I can prepare a minimal test spec and an allowlist script this week.

Irene
Lead, ISV Integrations

--
(Quoted text removed)

From: chloe.martin@redwood.ai
To: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@saasify.co>, marketplace_ops@cloudvendor.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, irene.choi@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Aug 2028 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: RE: SaaSify marketplace entitlement/ISV integration - dependency list & exemption request

Tom / Marketplace team — thanks for the patience while we assessed options. Summary and proposed path:

Decision (short-term): Redwood will request a temporary listing exemption from CloudVendor to allow SaaSify to publish with a "Limited trial" entitlements label. In parallel Redwood will deliver a lightweight entitlement header API (internal mapping) and a shim if needed. Concrete commitments:
- Redwood will submit the exemption request to MarketplaceOps today with the supporting test plan (Irene will attach).
- Engineering commitment: we can deliver the entitlement header + server acceptance and a basic reconciliation mapping by Aug 28 (target). This buys SaaSify time to onboard while we finish QA.
- Testing window: Aug 21–24 for SaaSify <> Redwood acceptance tests (staging endpoints + allowlist).

Next steps for SaaSify: please sign the marketplace amendment (DocuSign link included) agreeing to the limited trial terms and the acceptance window. Once signed we'll submit the exception with MarketplaceOps and schedule the staging tests.

Links/attachments:
- Tech spec (forwarded)
- Entitlement mapping draft: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aSaaSifyTechSpec
- DocuSign amendment: DOCUSIGN-987654

Tom, please confirm you accept the Aug 21–24 testing window and that SaaSify can sign the amendment today. If you prefer we can target an earlier internal delivery but Aug 28 is our conservative delivery date for the API.

Thanks — chloe
VP, Partnerships & Marketplace
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: SaaSify_Marketplace_TechSpec_v3.pdf (PDF), entitlement-matrix.csv (CSV)
